guards.guard: membership in the six-letter non-attaching set is a closed lexical fact, never guessed from shape resemblance to a member
a classification is a per-letter joining fact only; it is never promoted to a token, morpheme, root, entry, or sense boundary
neighbor context (preceding class, following presence) is declared evidence; an unlisted letter or missing context abstains rather than defaulting to a shape
the hamza-bearing alif variants are the one licensed unification; no other letter's hamza-bearing variant is folded into its base class without its own row
